Mapping application: ownership spine
|
|-- App
|   |-- MappingServices (created once; supplied through context)
|   |   |-- canvasHistory: DefaultCanvasHistoryService [H]
|   |   |-- workspaceStorage: WorkspaceStorage [P]
|   |   `-- diagramGenerator / codeRepo (shared service references)
|   `-- MappingPocPage / MappingServicesContext.Provider
|       `-- MappingWorkspacePage
|           |-- CanvasWorkspace
|           |   |-- drafts[documentId]: CanvasDraft
|           |   |   |-- DraftMetadata: name, repository, saved baseline, viewport
|           |   |   `-- CanvasSession (created from document + canvas + history)
|           |   |       |-- CanvasCursorCopy
|           |   |       |-- Read-only observable stores
|           |   |       |   |-- document / presentation / selection / controls
|           |   |       |   `-- geometry / status (dirty and undo flags)
|           |   |       |-- Saved baseline + cached scene/edge keys
|           |   |       |   `-- updateBaseline(): use acknowledged save, not later edits
|           |   |       |-- MappingDocumentController
|           |   |       |   |-- ControllerSnapshot
|           |   |       |   |   |-- MappingGridDocument [D]
|           |   |       |   |   `-- MappingCanvasState [D]
|           |   |       |   |-- Context handle -> shared history service [H]
|           |   |       |   |-- applyUpdate() / transact(): semantic operations
|           |   |       |   |   |-- -> attached editor driver.settle()
|           |   |       |   |   |-- Check expectedVersion; stage cloned state
|           |   |       |   |   `-- updateSnapshot(): reconcile + validate + normalize
|           |   |       |   |       |-- -> history.append(context, document, canvas)
|           |   |       |   |       `-- -> synchronous session subscribers
|           |   |       |   |-- updateCanvas(record=false): transient, no checkpoint
|           |   |       |   |-- undo(): driver if mounted; otherwise history.navigate()
|           |   |       |   `-- persistenceChanges(cursor) -> history delta [H,P]
|           |   |       `-- onCommit(): checkpoint ID changed -> workspace notification
|           |   |-- controllers Map: references to session controllers, not extra owners
|           |   |-- setDrafts(): replace/remove -> unsubscribe + session.dispose()
|           |   `-- onPersist(ids) -> WorkspacePersistence [P]
|           |-- MappingEditorCanvas (per mounted document; references its session)
|           |   |-- CanvasRuntime: interaction helpers
|           |   |-- Mounted tldraw Editor: live geometry + native undo
|           |   `-- MappingEditorRuntime (references Editor and controller)
|           |       |-- publish(): snapshot -> shapes, selection, mappingCheckpoint
|           |       |-- settle() -> controller.commitEditorGesture(): one checkpoint
|           |       |-- Native checkpoint change -> controller.restoreEditorCheckpoint()
|           |       `-- dispose(): settle, detach driver and listeners
|           |-- SourcePaneViewState: personal display/camera state [P]
|           |-- WorkspacePersistence: subscribes to workspace and personal view [P]
|           |-- PromptComposerCoordinator: page-lifetime drafts, requests, timers [A]
|           |-- DiagramRevisionReceiver: application receipts [A]
|           |-- useAgentCanvasBridge: command polling -> page handler [A]
|           `-- Startup: catalog + storage.load() -> reconcile -> workspace.setDrafts()
|
`-- /evals (rendered by App): alternate service consumer; not part of workspace

Sources: src/app/{App.tsx,services.ts}; src/features/mapping/MappingPage.tsx
         src/features/mapping/workspace/{canvasWorkspace,canvasSession}.ts
         domain/mapping/workspace/mappingDocumentController.ts
         src/features/mapping/tldraw/{MappingEditorCanvas.tsx,MappingEditorRuntime.ts}
